text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Hayahide! There you are!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I think I even surprised myself!
They said it's a new Yayoi
Sho record!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When I saw Taishin right behind me, I felt
this power surging up
inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She taught me that a rival can help you
draw out a strength in yourself
you didn't
even... know you h-had... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I know I lost, but... I ran one heck of a
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how unfair this is. I'm so
envious I didn't get to race
with you two.

If they keep this up, these three are
headed straight for the first race
of the
Classics, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose the next one. However good a
race I give, it's
meaningless if I don't win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I won't be missing the Satsuki Sho
either. Next time, we're in it
together.

The first showdown is over, and—having
raced her trusted
rival—Winning Ticket
smiles bigger than ever.

Now she'll push forward into the Classics
and her once-in-a-lifetime
dream, the
Japanese Derby.
